newsitem.title: INDIA: Unilever sale plan may affect India unit.
newsitem.headline: Unilever sale plan may affect India unit.

text.p: The Anglo-Dutch food and personal products group Unilever Plc's announcement that it intends to sell its international speciality chemicals business may impact the Hindustan Lever Ltd, the Indian subsidiary said.

"I have just come to learn from Unilever's announcement that it intends to sell its international speciality chemicals business -- National Starch & Chemicals Co, Quest International, Unichema International and Crosfield -- as part of the strategic development of its portfolio," Hindustan Lever chairman K.B.Dadiseth said in a statement on Tuesday.
"Many of the product categories of these companies are represented within Hindustan Lever Ltd," it said.
"The board of Hindustan Lever will consider the impact of this decision on its Indian operations in due course," it said.
